observations: Current Axum 0.8 documentation (0.8.9) confirms middleware::from_fn receives an axum Request and Next, and Next::run(self, req: Request) forwards the same request into the remaining service stack.

Axum's from_fn authorization example shows request-derived authentication running before next.run(request), which preserves the insertion point established in worker revision 52: authenticated middleware can mutate request extensions before rmcp service dispatch.

The current source search did not return the rust-lang http crate Extensions page; one hit was the unrelated http-types-rs crate. Those unrelated bounds are explicitly quarantined and are not used as evidence for http 1.x.

Therefore the exact Principal trait bounds required by http::Extensions::insert/get remain source-unverified in this bounded slice. The likely Clone/Send/Sync/'static shape is not promoted to a finding until direct http 1.x source is read.

The predecessor rmcp-v3.1.4 finding remains narrowly scoped: rmcp exposes inbound http::request::Parts through RequestContext extensions, so the intended handler chain is RequestContext.extensions.get::<http::request::Parts>() then parts.extensions.get::<Principal>(); this slice does not broaden that finding.

Fail-closed behavior remains application policy, not an rmcp/axum guarantee: the handler candidate must reject the call if either Parts or Principal is absent rather than falling back to client-controlled _meta identity.
